verdict.rationale: Manufact ships a few built-in event-driven automations. Pushing to the production branch auto-triggers a deployment, a publish checklist can start automatically after each successful deployment, and a 'Deployment paths & triggers' settings section exists. These are fixed, platform-defined triggers rather than user-authored rules mapping arbitrary events to arbitrary actions. missing for 10: a general user-defined rules/automation engine, configurable event types (e.g. observability or gateway events) triggering custom actions, webhooks or outbound notifications on events, detailed trigger-configuration docs, independent hands-on corroboration.
